annotations.title: Crawl a site into a dataset

description: COLLECTS a site or a section into a queryable, change-tracked dataset (one row per page). Scope: intent (a section, in plain words), rank_cap=N (the top N items of a listing), seed_urls (known pages), or the whole site capped by page_budget. Modes: markdown (default, no AI), extract_mode='schema' (uniform records), executor='ai' + extract_prompt (per-page understanding, 5x the page rate). A bounded crawl answers with its rows; an open one returns a crawl_id for writ_crawl_status wait=true. NOT FOR: reading a few pages now (writ_scrape). Every option: writ_help('writ_crawl_site').

executor.description: regular (default, no AI) | ai (5x the page rate).

extract_prompt.description: With executor=ai: what to extract from each page.

intent.description: The section wanted, in plain words; the server derives paths and depth.

rank_cap.description: Top N items of a listing (one page per agent, in parallel).

wait.description: Hold until done and return the rows (default true when bounded).

name: writ_crawl_site
title: Crawl a site into a dataset
